entries.30개월 이하의 유아는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하기 전에: Do not use this medicine in infants aged 30 months or younger. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced hypersensitivity to medicines or cosmetics (rash, redness (congested and reddened skin), itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like), if you have an allergic constitution, if you have severe moist (damp) or eroded (macerated) skin, or if the user is a child. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine externally only and do not use it internally. Be careful to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water. If symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.다른 소독제와 혼합하여 사용하지 마십시오.외용으로만 사용하십시오.비누류는: Do not mix this medicine with other disinfectants. Use it externally only. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. Be careful to keep the undiluted or concentrated solution out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse the eyes thoroughly with water. When a concentrated solution is used, irritation of the skin and mucous membranes may occur, so use it with care. If iron instruments have to be immersed for a long time, dissolve sodium nitrite in the solution to prevent corrosion, except for copper items. (This does not affect the bactericidal action.)
entries.면봉이나 깨끗한 손으로 소량을 덜어 통증 부위에 바릅니다.20분 이상 기: Pick up a small amount with a cotton swab or a clean hand and apply it to the painful area. If the pain continues after waiting 20 minutes or more, this medicine may be applied again, after which further applications should be at least 3 hours apart.
entries.외용으로만 사용하십시오.원액 또는 농후액이 눈에 들어가지 않도록 주의하고: Use it externally only. Be careful to keep the undiluted or concentrated solution out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse the eyes thoroughly with water. When a concentrated solution is used, irritation of the skin and mucous membranes may occur, so use it with care. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use. If iron instruments have to be immersed for a long time, dissolve sodium nitrite in the solution to prevent corrosion, except for copper items. (This does not affect the bactericidal action.)
entries.원액으로 사용합니다.이 약은 다음과 같은 순서대로 사용합니다.의료기구를: Use it as the undiluted solution. Use this medicine in the following order. Immerse the medical instruments completely in the disinfectant solution for about 1 minute (within 5 minutes). For instruments with fine pores, such as endoscopes, be careful to ensure sufficient contact. After thorough immersion, remove the items and rinse them under running sterile purified water for at least 15 seconds, or with water according to the purpose of use. For instruments with fine pores or a complex structure the disinfectant solution tends to remain inside, so rinse thoroughly by pressure-injecting sterile purified water or water, or by extending the rinsing time.
entries.이 약 조제 시 미온수 1리터당 이 약 분말 16.2 g을 넣고 분말이: When preparing this medicine, add 16.2 g of the powder of this medicine per 1 litre of lukewarm water and mix well until the powder is completely dissolved into a clear blue-green solution. Activation requires 15 minutes, and after about 30 minutes the solution turns colourless. After washing the instruments to be sterilised thoroughly, immerse them completely in this activated solution and leave them soaking for 10 minutes. Rinse the instruments completely with sterile water so that no solution remains. Use them after drying, or store them by an appropriate method.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 뇌, 척수, 귀(내이, 중이, 외이), 질, 방광: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it, and do not use it on the brain, spinal cord, ear (inner, middle or outer ear), vagina, bladder, oral cavity or other mucosal surfaces, on the eyes, or on eroded (macerated) or suppurating affected areas. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines or cosmetics, if you have an allergic constitution, if it is to be applied around the vulva immediately before delivery, or if the affected area is extensive with severe wounds or severe burns. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine externally only and do not use it internally. Be careful to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. If soap is used, wash it off thoroughly beforehand and then use this medicine. Anions form poorly soluble salts, so use clean distilled water when diluting it. Before use, wash the wounded area and the contaminants around it thoroughly. If there is no improvement in the symptoms after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 뇌, 척수, 귀, 질, 방광, 구강 등의 점막면,: Do not administer this medicine to patients with hypersensitivity to it, or to the brain, spinal cord, ear, vagina, bladder, oral cavity or other mucosal surfaces, or to the eyes. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are a patient with hypersensitivity to other medicines, if you have experienced an allergic reaction such as asthma, if it is to be applied around the vulva immediately before delivery, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. Ophthalmic devices with glass or metal joints are corroded by this medicine, so do not use it on them. Use this medicine externally only. Contact with the eyes may cause corneal damage, so be careful to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get in, rinse them thoroughly with clean water immediately. This medicine is adsorbed onto textiles and cloth (cotton, gauze, wool, rayon and the like), so when it is used by soaking such material, supply fresh solution whenever the effective concentration is no longer maintained. Anions contained in saline and similar solutions form poorly soluble salts, so use clean distilled water when diluting it. Replace the diluted solution used for washing the hands and similar purposes with fresh solution at least once a day.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.12시간 이내 면도한: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Do not use it on skin shaved within the previous 12 hours or on damaged or irritated skin. Before using this medicine, pregnant women, breastfeeding women and children (aged 12 years or younger) should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it only on the area to be treated. Avoid contact with the eyes, nostrils, mouth or other mucous membranes. If accidental contact occurs, wash it off thoroughly with water. When a breastfeeding woman uses it, be careful that this medicine does not touch the breast area. If it does, wash off every trace of the medicine thoroughly, however small, before starting to breastfeed. To avoid a burning sensation of the skin, dry the treatment area completely before using this medicine. Avoid direct contact with clothing, jewellery and polished metal surfaces.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.벗겨지거나 손상된 피부: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Do not apply it to broken or damaged skin or to recently shaved areas. It must be used only on the area to be treated, and the application area must be kept completely dry. Be careful that it does not touch the eyes or mucous membranes. Bathing must be avoided immediately before applying this medicine and must also be avoided for one hour after application. Do not remove underarm hair within 12 hours before or after applying this medicine.

Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Do not use it on broken or damaged skin or on recently shaved areas. It must be used only on the area to be treated, and it must be applied after the application area has been kept completely dry. Be careful that it does not touch the eyes or mucous membranes. Bathing must be avoided immediately before applying this medicine, and at least one hour must have passed after application. Do not remove underarm hair within 12 hours before or after applying this medicine.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약은 벗겨지거나 손: Do not use this medicine in patients with hypersensitivity to it. Do not apply this medicine to broken or damaged skin or to recently shaved areas. It must be used only on the area to be treated, and the application area must be kept completely dry. Be careful that it does not touch the eyes or mucous membranes. Bathing must be avoided immediately before applying this medicine, and at least one hour must have passed after application. Do not remove underarm hair within 12 hours before or after applying this medicine.
entries.이 약은 외용으로만 사용하십시오.눈에 들어가지 않도록 주의하십시오.깊은,: Use this medicine externally only. Be careful to keep it out of the eyes. Do not use it on deep, puncture or lacerated wounds or on infected areas. Wash the affected area thoroughly before applying it.
entries.이 약은 인화성으로 담배불과 같은 발화성 물질로부터 멀리 보관하십시오.외: This medicine is flammable, so keep it away from ignition sources such as lit cigarettes. Use it externally only; it must not be used internally.
entries.이 약은 희석하지 않고 원액 그대로 사용합니다.수술시 수술자의 손 소독에: Use this medicine undiluted, as the neat solution. When it is used for hand disinfection by the operator during surgery, dispense 5 mL of this medicine into the palm, spread it evenly over both hands and arms (up to the elbows), then rub for at least 3 minutes while allowing it to dry, and carry this out 2 times. When it is used for hand disinfection for hygienic purposes, dispense 3 mL of this medicine into the palm, spread it evenly over both hands, then rub for 30 seconds while allowing it to dry.
entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 약 또는 화장품에 알레르기 증상(발진, 발적, 가: Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines or cosmetics (rash, redness, itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like), if you have an allergic constitution, or if the affected area is extensive with severe wounds or severe burns. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. If it gets into the eyes, rinse them immediately with cold water and then consult a doctor. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine externally only and do not use it internally. If there is no improvement in the symptoms after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.일반 피부 및 상처부위 세정 시 세정할 부위를 물로 닦고, 피부나 상처에: For general cleansing of the skin and wounded areas, wet the area to be cleansed with water, use only the minimum amount needed for application to the skin or wound, apply it and then wipe it off gently. Then rinse thoroughly with water. For personal hand disinfection, wet the hands with water, apply 5 mL of this product to the hands and rub both hands vigorously for 15 seconds. Then rinse with water and dry completely.
entries.일반 피부 및 상처부위 세정에는 세정할 부위를 물로 닦고, 피부나 상처에: For cleansing of general skin and wounded areas, wet the area to be cleansed with water, use only the minimum amount needed for application to the skin or wound, apply it, then wipe it off gently and rinse thoroughly with water. For hand disinfection during surgery, wet the hands and forearms with water, apply 5 mL of this product to the hands and up to the elbows and rub for about 3 minutes using a brush or a sponge. Rinse thoroughly under running water, repeat the above procedure once more and then dry completely. For personal hand disinfection, wet the hands with water, apply 5 mL of this product to the hands and rub both hands vigorously for 15 seconds. Rinse with water and dry completely. For disinfection of the skin before surgery, apply a sufficient amount to the surgical site and rub for at least 2 minutes. Dry with a sterile towel, repeat the above procedure once more and then dry with a sterile towel.

For cleansing of general skin and wounded areas, wet the area to be cleansed with water, use only the minimum amount needed for application to the skin or wound, apply it and then wipe it off gently. Rinse thoroughly with water. For hand disinfection during surgery, wet the hands and forearms with water, apply 5 mL of this product to the hands and up to the elbows and rub for about 3 minutes using a brush or a sponge. Rinse thoroughly under running water, repeat the above procedure once more and then dry completely. For personal hand disinfection, wet the hands with water, apply 5 mL of this product to the hands and rub both hands vigorously for 15 seconds. Rinse with water and dry completely. For disinfection of the skin before surgery, apply a sufficient amount to the surgical site and rub for at least 2 minutes. Dry with a sterile towel, repeat the above procedure once more and then dry with a sterile towel.
entries.클로르헥시딘에 과민증 환자, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성: Patients with hypersensitivity to chlorhexidine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, anyone who has experienced allergic symptoms (such as asthma) should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine externally only. Do not use it on the head, the face, areas in contact with the meninges, the genital area, wounds deeper than the surface layer of the skin, the eyes, the ears, the mouth, extensive wounds or burns. Be careful to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with clean water. Soaps weaken the bactericidal action of this medicine, so wash them off thoroughly before use.
entries.혈액공급이 불충분한 부위, 상처부위, 눈, 점막 및 궤양 부위에는 이 약: Do not use this medicine on areas with insufficient blood supply, on wounded areas, on the eyes, on mucous membranes or on ulcerated areas. Follow the specified dosage and administration exactly. When using it on a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use it topically on the skin only. Be careful to keep it out of the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water.
